findings.rationale: Update norms are near zero in most rounds (norm_ratio exactly 0 or below 0.08 in rounds 1,3,4,5,7,8,9,10,11,16,18,20), with full-size updates (norm_ratio about 1.0-1.5) only in rounds 2,6,12-15,17,19. Consistent with uploading the global model back without training in roughly 60% of rounds. Client-level median norm ratio is 0.0118 (z=-13.2 in the all-client screen), far outside the federation spread. Local performance is normal, so this is not label noise or drift.

Update norms are zero in rounds 1,3,8,9,10,11,16,18,20 and near zero (below 0.05) in rounds 4,5,7. Normal-sized updates (about 0.8-1.3) appear only in rounds 2,6,12-15,17,19. This is the free-rider pattern. Client-level median norm ratio is 0.0051 (z=-9.3 in the all-client screen), with min cos -0.66 (z=-4.4). Its local AUC and calibration are normal.

Updates are zero or near zero in many rounds (rounds 3,5,7,8,9,10,11,16,18 with norm_ratio at or below 0.02) and near normal size in others (rounds 2,6,12-15,17,19). Client-level norm statistics are anomalous in the all-client screen (min_norm_ratio z=-7.7, median_norm_ratio z=-5.1). Local performance is normal.

report.summary: Screened all 52 clients with the all-client views of client_updates, client_performance, drift_by_round, feature_summary and subgroup_outcomes (Sex, AgeGroup, Income), then confirmed leads with narrower queries. Three clients (HI, KS, MI) show the free-rider signature: update norms are zero or near zero in roughly half of all rounds, with normal-sized updates in the rest, and their local performance is normal. I reported all three with moderate-to-high confidence. Other leads did not hold up: the ME Income-group-5 subgroup gap moved substantially between queries (predicted risk 0.023 then 0), AL's drift onset (round 5) was indistinguishable from noise at the epsilon spent, and the remaining subgroup and feature outliers are scattered, small-subgroup deviations consistent with chance. No drift, label-noise, prevalence-shift, poisoning, missing-artefact or explanation-instability client stood out after noise adjustment. Budget used: 19.9 of 20.0 epsilon.
